gate3.note: No core filter was added; broad-market sleeve remains default-off paper only.

hypothesis: Already-selected broad-market leadership paper candidates with high trend efficiency may carry standalone path quality beyond raw rank and raw persistence; a bounded support notional scalar can improve allocation after the accepted rank, low-extension, high-volatility, and trend-persistence stack.
interpretation: Trend efficiency is a new production-visible quality field aligned with the playbook's healthy-persistence direction. Promotion still requires identity control plus the same three-window gate as other broad-market paper allocation fields.

llm_metrics.reason: This run avoids sparse LLM soft-ranking and does not alter LLM prompts or decisions.

next_evidence_needed: Collect forward broad-market paper outcomes with trend-efficiency metadata; do not retry adjacent trend-efficiency thresholds on the frozen sample without new forward evidence or a distinct quality field.

protocol_answers.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool/capital allocation: smooth 20-day trend paths may deserve bounded paper notional support after selection.
protocol_answers.2_past_similar_experiments: Broad-market price-floor, rank-notional, low-extension ret5, high-volatility, trend-persistence, strong-close crowding, recent-repeat, and absolute-score support were tested; trend-efficiency support was not previously formalized for this sleeve.
protocol_answers.3_single_variable: Only trend_efficiency_20_min/scalar changes inside one notional-support field; eligibility, rank profile, low-extension, high-volatility, trend-persistence, hold, slots, and universe controls stay fixed.
protocol_answers.4_acceptance: Gate 4 requires positive aggregate EV/PnL, all 3 windows EV-positive, no EV/PnL regression windows, >=8 adjusted trades across all 3 windows, concentration guard, and <=0.5pp max drawdown worsening.
protocol_answers.5_reproducibility: Script, JSON artifact, log, ticket, markdown artifact, and JSONL identify windows, parameters, and metrics.

rejection_reason: Trend-efficiency support did not clear the broad-market three-window gate and/or identity control.
single_causal_variable: trend-efficiency support scalar for fixed broad-market selected candidates
